tickerText: [TENNIS] Fils vs Tiafoe & Gauff vs Pegula headline Cincinnati finals today — first all-American women's final since 1970 • [SQUASH] Budapest Open kicks off Aug 24; Pérez lifts Valencia title in 110-min epic over Evans • [BADMINTON] BWF Worlds finals day in Delhi — An Se-young faces Yamaguchi; Liu/Tan take women's doubles gold • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals open 2026-27 PPA season Aug 31 in Cary — World Pickleball Rankings debut • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13; Lebrun & Wang Manyu fresh off Malmö Grand Smash wins

newsItems.title: Cincinnati Finals Day: Fils-Tiafoe & Gauff-Pegula
newsItems.excerpt: Arthur Fils and Frances Tiafoe clash in the men's final after semifinal wins over Cobolli and Nakashima, while Coco Gauff and Jessica Pegula meet in the first all-American women's final since 1970.

newsItems.title: Pérez Wins Valencia in 110-Minute Epic
newsItems.excerpt: Spain's Iván Pérez edged Rhys Evans 3-2 in a gripping PSA Valencia final, converting his second Copper title after surviving a fourth-set tiebreak and a deciding-game push.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026-27 Carvana PPA Tour kicks off Aug 31 in Cary with the Veolia Pickleball National Championships, debuting the unified World Pickleball Rankings system.

newsItems.title: WTT Macao & Malmö Champions
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13 with 64 top singles players, while Felix Lebrun and Wang Manyu claimed Malmö Grand Smash crowns earlier this month.
